# MailXaminer

> > MailXaminer is a trusted email forensics platform designed for law enforcement and digital investigators to detect, analyze, and prosecute evidence from email systems.

MailXaminer provides comprehensive email forensics software with advanced features for evidence collection, keyword searching, and case management. The platform supports multiple email clients and formats, maintains chain of custody compliance, and enables investigators to generate court-ready forensic reports.
